args.subject: Group Booking Enquiry - City Hub - 10 Guests in June
args.body:
Hello,

I am organising a group stay at City Hub for 10 people in June and would like to ask about availability.

Could you please let me know:
1. Whether you have availability in June for a group of 10 guests, and for which dates;
2. What room types or configurations can accommodate a group of this size;
3. Any group rates, deposit requirements, or booking conditions that may apply.

Thank you very much for your help. I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
